title: Senior Backend Engineer
description_html:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team.

  • Design and maintain Python/Django services handling millions of ad impressions per day
  • Optimize PostgreSQL queries and Redis caching layers
  • Build asynchronous task pipelines with Celery and RabbitMQ
  • Deploy on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Write clean, tested Python code — we use pytest extensively

Nice to have: experience with Temporal for workflow orchestration.

title: Data Engineer
description_html:
Join our data platform team to build and maintain our analytics infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain Apache Spark pipelines processing terabytes of billing data
  • Manage Kafka topics for real-time event streaming
  • Orchestrate workflows with Apache Airflow
  • Load data into Snowflake via dbt transformations
  • Python is our primary language; experience with Scala is a plus

Our stack also includes Databricks for ML workloads and ClickHouse for real-time analytics.

title: ML Engineer
description_html:
AlayaCare is seeking an ML Engineer to productionize machine learning models for home care scheduling.

  • Train and evaluate models using PyTorch and scikit-learn
  • Build feature pipelines with Pandas and NumPy
  • Serve models via FastAPI endpoints
  • Manage experiments with MLflow
  • Infrastructure runs on GCP with Kubernetes

We are exploring LLM-based approaches for care plan summarization — experience with RAG pipelines is a strong asset.

title: Software Developer
description_html:
We are looking for a talented Software Developer to join our growing team in Montreal.

You will work on exciting digital transformation projects for our clients across various industries. You bring strong problem-solving skills, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for delivering quality software. Agile methodologies and clean code are important to us.

Send us your CV and we will be in touch!

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description_html:
We are growing our platform engineering team and looking for a Senior Platform Engineer.

  • Build and operate distributed systems in Go
  • Own our Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS)
  • Design service-to-service communication using gRPC and Temporal for workflow orchestration
  • Maintain PostgreSQL clusters and Redis caches
  • Improve observability with Prometheus and Grafana

title: Frontend Engineer
description_html:
Plusgrade is looking for a Frontend Engineer to build our next-generation airline upsell platform.

  • Build React components with TypeScript and test them with Jest and React Testing Library
  • Consume GraphQL APIs and manage state with Apollo Client
  • Implement pixel-perfect UI from Figma designs using Tailwind CSS
  • Contribute to our Next.js-based microfrontend architecture

title: Backend Engineer — Go
description_html:
Join Mirego's backend team to build high-throughput APIs for our mobile platform clients.

  • Write idiomatic Go services with clean interfaces and strong test coverage
  • Design gRPC contracts for inter-service communication
  • Deploy services to Kubernetes on GCP using Helm charts
  • Use PostgreSQL and Redis; experiment with Temporal for long-running workflows
  • Participate in on-call rotations and production incident response

title: Full Stack Developer
description_html:
Osedea is hiring a Full Stack Developer to work on custom software for our clients.

  • Build responsive UIs with React.js and TypeScript
  • Develop REST APIs using Node.js and Express
  • Write Golang microservices for compute-heavy tasks
  • Work with PostgreSQL and MongoDB depending on the project
  • Ship features using our CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions

title: DevOps Engineer
description_html:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to strengthen our infrastructure team.

  • Manage AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible
  • Administer Kubernetes clusters and define resource policies
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions
  • Monitor services with Prometheus, Grafana, and PagerDuty
  • Harden security posture and manage IAM policies

title: Data Analyst
description_html:
Broadsign is looking for a Data Analyst to support our ad operations and revenue teams.

  • Build dashboards and reports in Tableau and Looker
  • Write SQL queries against BigQuery and Snowflake
  • Automate reporting with Python (pandas, openpyxl)
  • Partner with engineering to define tracking requirements and data models

title: Platform Engineer
description_html:
AppDirect's platform engineering team is looking for an engineer to own core infrastructure.

  • Build internal developer platform tooling in Go
  • Operate multi-region Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS
  • Implement async workflows with Temporal and RabbitMQ for event-driven architecture
  • Maintain PostgreSQL and DynamoDB data stores
  • Own our Terraform modules and GitOps pipeline
